entries.description: umace dedoo ne a hanmaor cii
entries.subject: umace dedoo

spans.text: doo u ior sha won cii kua ityar i ve lu ker ia nongo tsung u umbur kwagh u vesen u i har sha mi ne, sha u tesen ken makeranta man shi u pasen ior er, doo u vea wa iko a mlu gbar gbar u umace shi vea nôngo tsung er, hanma tar sha tseeneke u u, shin ua zua ave vea ityar igen, u kuran ityendezwa i eren a umace dedoo ne a hanmaor cii.

entries.task_id: er myee|ne|a tese shin u kenden ior asema sha imba i msange u sha dooshima la nahn yô
entries.description: er Myee ne a tese shin u kenden ior asema sha imba i msange u sha dooshima la nahn yô
entries.subject: er Myee
entries.object: a tese shin u kenden ior asema sha imba i msange u sha dooshima la nahn yô

spans.text: Tindi ver ishigh er, ior cii ve lu kwagh môm man shi ve lu a ian u a kura ve er tindi a tese nahan, a msange u sha dooshima shio, ior cii mba a ian u kuran ve aluer ma msange u sha dooshima u i per un er Myee ne a tese shin u kenden ior asema sha imba i msange u sha dooshima la nahn yô, ka sha mi ga.

entries.task_id: nan ijir|ne|nan ibo sha makwagh u iyange nan er kpa tindi lu sha min hen shie la ga ze
entries.description: nan ijir ne nan ibo sha makwagh u iyange nan er kpa tindi lu sha min hen shie la ga ze
entries.subject: nan ijir
entries.object: nan ibo sha makwagh u iyange nan er kpa tindi lu sha min hen shie la ga ze

spans.text: Maor môm i de er nan ijir ne nan ibo sha makwagh u iyange nan er kpa tindi lu sha min hen shie la ga ze.

entries.task_id: i de|ne|or mtsaha hemban u iyange ma i na nan shie u iyange nan er kwaghbo la ga
entries.description: i de ne or mtsaha hemban u iyange ma i na nan shie u iyange nan er kwaghbo la ga
entries.subject: i de
entries.object: or mtsaha hemban u iyange ma i na nan shie u iyange nan er kwaghbo la ga

spans.text: Shi i de ne or mtsaha hemban u iyange ma i na nan shie u iyange nan er kwaghbo la ga.

entries.task_id: u ivese|ne|doo u vea lu lianaa or a hemba orgen ga
entries.description: u ivese ne doo u vea lu lianaa or a hemba orgen ga
entries.subject: u ivese
entries.object: doo u vea lu lianaa or a hemba orgen ga

spans.text: Shie u ivese ne doo u vea lu lianaa or a hemba orgen ga, aluer ivese pav yô, gba u a kar kwar vough.

entries.task_id: ian|ne|i kua mba-mnenge mba nan a ikighir shio
entries.description: ian ne i kua mba-mnenge mba nan a ikighir shio
entries.subject: ian
entries.object: i kua mba-mnenge mba nan a ikighir shio

spans.text: Hanmaor ngu a ian gbar gbar i lun a mhen u nan man ôron kwagh u nan soo yô, ian ne i kua mba-mnenge mba nan a ikighir shio, shi i tagher nan ga u keren shin ngohol kwagh u nan soo man mhen u nana zua a mi sha hanma gbenda cii ken igbar.
